integrity: All claims follow from the explicit central-extension classification; direct computational enumeration is supplementary, not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Complete count concerns only the 5-dimensional free class-three Lie algebra on two generators, not other free Lie algebra ranks/classes.
Potential equivalent older formulas in local subring zeta literature remain a priority risk; source PDF for F_{3,2} was inaccessible.
Verification enumerates q=2,3,4; the proof handles all prime powers.
title: Subalgebra-dimension enumeration for the free rank-two class-three Lie algebra
